audit.why: This is an engage mirror; Nautilus wins every stage because his hook is point-and-click-adjacent and his ult is unstoppable versus Maokai's skillshot-ish W and slow, dodgeable ult. Chart and prose agree throughout.
Spikes correctly key Level 2 all-in, Level 6 unstoppable Depth Charge vs slow Nature's Grasp, first item engage-priority, and late R-catch superiority.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were copy-pasted trade lines under titles that promise something else (a counter-hook tip and a Flash-timing warning), so two real missingInteractions — Q grounding Twisted Advance's dash, and Nature's Grasp cutting off Nautilus's only retreat since he has no dash — never reached the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions[9] lists 'enemy-dash-deniable' (Dredge Line shuts off Twisted Advance) and 'terrain-cuts-retreat' (Nature's Grasp plus no owner dash means hold Flash for the wall). Both are concrete, kit-grounded facts that fit the existing titles exactly.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the grounding interaction; dontsFull[2].d now states the Flash-for-the-wall interaction.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Dredge Line shuts off Twisted Advance mid-cast — hook him before the dash lands and his root whiffs.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp walls your escape and you carry no dash — save Flash for the wall, not for chip damage.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. It writes your spacing rules. - W Titan's Wrath is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root, 14/13/12/11/10s CD): matchup-defining — count its cooldown before stepping up. It writes your spacing rules. - W Titan's Wrath (12s CD) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

notes: Both suspectNames flags are false positives: 'Nature's Grasp' and 'Sapling Toss' exactly match enemyAbilities R and E — no correction needed. Remaining missingInteractions (untargetable-dodges-burst on W, needs-antiheal on P, knockup-enabler race) are already partly covered by existing report[8] anti-heal itemization line and the R-catch framing in whys/spikes; left alone since no lint flag or fabrication risk pointed to them and the sweep fields were already grounded.
